seuil.title: The Threshold
seuil.narrator: Underwater, even the sacred eventually sinks — but not always into oblivion.
seuil.text:
You cross the arch — episode 5 behind you, the portal ahead.

Your HUD:

**140 m remaining · depth 675 m · lamp 7% · heading 214°**

The nave opens — vast black stone, columns swallowed by water. **Pumpkins** carved in every capital, eroded faces, frozen smiles.

Fableris runes pulse faintly on the walls — orange, like the distant glow.

Here, the wreck clattering no longer follows. **Chosen** silence. Or **forbidden**.

choices.text: Charge toward the altar — central axis
Follow the side aisle — read the runes

nef.title: Flooded Nave
nef.narrator: A nave without worshippers still keeps the direction of prayer.
nef.text:
You advance.

The water is **calmer** here — no current, no debris. As if the cathedral **pushed** the ocean back around the altar.

At **710 m**, your lamp weakens: **6%**.

The altar pulses at the far end — carved stone arch, **living** Halloween glow.

Two paths:

**A — Central aisle** (direct · exposed)
**B — Side chapel** (crypt · hides a dead **Fableris lantern**)

choices.text: Side chapel — search for emergency light

audace_allee.title: Central Aisle
audace_allee.narrator: Swimming straight toward a light sometimes means accepting being seen.
audace_allee.text:
You swim down the centre of the nave.

The carved pumpkins **watch** you — parallax, you tell yourself. Nothing else.

Your lamp: **5%**. The beam trembles.

Midway, the radio — clear, **present**:

*« —{{player}}. Don't stop. The altar is a door. — »*

On the floor: a pattern — spiral downward. **Descend** still. The altar is not the bottom.

choices.text: 🔦 Keep the lamp on — sprint for the altar

lucidite_chapelle.title: Side Chapel
lucidite_chapelle.narrator: Side chapels keep the secrets the nave refuses to shout.
lucidite_chapelle.text:
You slip into a narrow chapel.

Minor altar. Floating offerings — capsules, Coalition badges, **carved names**.

On the wall, a Fableris inscription:

*« Here the portal waits. The world's lamp goes out. The ritual one does not. »*

You find a **ritual lantern** — dark for decades. You shake it. Nothing.

But replacing it, you **switch off** your own lamp for a minute — saving power. When you switch on again: **6%** — you gained a step.

The nave calls you toward the main altar.

autel.title: The Altar
autel.narrator: An altar underwater offers no forgiveness — only a passage.
autel.text:
You reach it.

The altar is hollow — orange stone **ring**, Halloween runes **turning** slowly in the water like fish of light.

At the centre: void. Then, when your lamp **flickers** — **4%** — the ring reveals what it hides:

A vertical **shaft**. Smooth walls. Glow below — **SECTOR 7**. At last.

Your HUD:

**55 m remaining · depth 770 m**

The radio, a breath:

*« —Go down. The lamp will die. The portal won't. — »*

choices.text: Wait for the lamp to stabilise

lampe.title: Blackout
lampe.narrator: When your last light goes out, sometimes another — older — takes over.
lampe.text:
Last flicker.

**Off.**

Battery: **0%** displayed. Done.

Except the altar **ring** ignites — bright orange, steady. Enough to see the shaft. Enough to **breathe**.

You're no longer alone with your fear. The cathedral **lends** its light — ritual loan, ancient debt.

Two possible gestures:

**A — Dive immediately** (trust)
**B — Touch the ring — read the central rune** (understanding)

choices.text: Dive into the shaft — without hesitation
Read the rune — understand before you jump

audace_puits.title: Ritual Fall
audace_puits.narrator: Some falls underwater aren't accidents — they're initiations.
audace_puits.text:
You dive.

The shaft **guides** you — no wall, no handhold. Just the glow rising to meet you.

Controlled speed. Stable pressure — Fableris suit still holding.

At **795 m**, you slow.

Ahead: a **circular chamber**. Runes. Pumpkins. And at the centre, an **arc of light** — edge of the Halloween portal, barely open.

**25 m remaining.**

The ritual light dies behind you. The portal **is enough**.

choices.text: Move toward the arc of light

lucidite_rune.title: The Central Rune
lucidite_rune.narrator: Reading before you jump is sometimes the only difference between passage and trap.
lucidite_rune.text:
You place your hand on the ring.

The central rune lights under your palm:

*« Whoever enters without their own light borrows ours. Whoever reads will repay the debt at the portal. »*

You understand: the cathedral isn't a shelter. It's a **filter**. Those who rush pass. Those who read **know** what awaits.

You dive — slow, deliberate.

The shaft descends. **795 m**. Circular chamber. Arc of light. Portal ajar.

**25 m remaining.**

Without your lamp. With certainty.

fin_cathedrale.title: Portal Chamber
fin_cathedrale.narrator: A few metres from the threshold, an entire ocean planet fits in the silence.
fin_cathedrale.text:
You enter the chamber.

**810 m**. **25 metres** from the portal. Enough to see it — not enough to cross. Not yet.

The Halloween arc pulses — orange, alive, **familiar** as a childhood memory and alien as an open mouth.

Your lamp: dead. The portal **lights** your face.

The radio, for the first time without static:

*« —{{player}}. Last step. You know what to do. — »*

**END EPISODE 6 — The Cathedral**

*Episode 7: The Portal — coming soon*
